_comment: The TSPML mod catalog. A CURATED LIST, not a search index: there is no
backend behind it, so there are no ratings, no download counts, and no
version history. The UI says so where it is browsed.
Read through lib/registry.ts, which validates every row and DROPS anything
malformed rather than defaulting it. tests/registry.test.ts validates this
file in CI, so a bad commit fails before it deploys.
source.url may be relative. It resolves against whatever origin serves this
file, which is why the portal's own sample entries are relative: a hardcoded
https://tspml.vercel.app/... would make a local dev server install from
production and look like it worked.
'format' is required and reserved: 'tspml' installs, 'pml' renders as a named
refusal rather than being installed wrong. Adding an entry is a PR.

entries.name: TSPML sample URL mod
entries.author: TSPML
entries.summary: A tiny mod served by the portal itself. Install it to see the whole path work end to end, from this list into a running game.

entries.name: TSPML sample pack mod

entries.summary: A second tiny mod, so the sample modpack has more than one line in it. Harmless on its own.

entries.name: TSPML sample modpack
entries.author: TSPML
entries.summary: Both sample mods at once. A modpack is a plain text file of mod URLs, one per line, and installs each of them separately.
